name: Porcelain Loom Sanctuary
core_rationale: Innermost translucent white-porcelain sanctuary town of Continent 01 at [1, 1] where Lantern-Keepers tend Sola's Hearth-Loom above the Medallion Heart Vault.

terrain_tile.water_feature: Warm luminous spring-canals reflecting translucent white-gold porcelain domes

North.lock_message: Boiling lotus-glaze steam curtains seal the northern Lotus Kiln Rim; Loom-Mother Cera requires the Medallion Heart-Chime before opening the northern terrace.

resident_npcs.name: Loom-Mother Cera
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Welcome to Porcelain Loom Sanctuary! Here at our 0.58 meter celadon weaving-table, Sola's warmth spins new spirit-lanterns for every Sprout.

resident_npcs.name: Chime-Warden Orin
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Beneath our sanctuary lies the Medallion Heart Vault. Retrieve the Medallion Heart-Chime below if you wish to part the steam curtains of Lotus Kiln Rim!

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors Porcelain Cradle Sanctuary at [1, 1] directly above Sola's unbroken ceramic boss-medallion.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Translucent white-gold porcelain domes glowing softly over warm spring-canals.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Weaving-tables at 0.58m, porcelain risers at 0.14m, doorways 2.10m x 1.55m, and 13.0m walkways for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Symmetric West portal to hunting-area-celadon-causeway, Dungeon portal to dungeon-medallion-heart-vault, and North fog_of_lore portal to hunting-area-lotus-kiln-rim.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Seals the northern Lotus Kiln Rim behind a fog_of_lore boundary portal and Loom-Mother lock message.
